correctness.rationale: The exact 0,m,2m projector decomposition yields the stated all-entry formulas. Same-part off diagonals are a positive polynomial fraction and cross-part entries strictly positive for h>0. The diagonal polynomial P_m has the m=5 sum-of-squares positivity certificate, and for m≥6 two simple positive roots by a negative value at x=8, positive endpoints and exactly two Descartes sign changes; P6 factorization gives the first exact endpoint. Independent exact-rational replay verified 77 matrix-identity cases and 9680 entries. All h and m claims are proven symbolically, not inferred from finite tests.

value.rationale: For graph heat diffusion, nonnegativity of the transition matrix is necessary and sufficient to preserve all nonnegative initial vectors. The exact all-step result shows a qualitative loss-and-return phenomenon despite Radau L-stability, establishes the smallest balanced biclique where it happens, and computes the only possible failure location (diagonal). This provides an intrinsic structural classification and practical sharp timestep test for an infinite family, not a routine one-off evaluation.
